title: What to Expect from Your Emsculpt NEO® Appointment?
paragraphs: We all have trouble areas on our bodies, which can cause worry. Body fat can bother anyone and not only health-conscious individuals. People try out ways to get rid of body fat with exercise, healthy eating habits, and other methods. It plays a significant role in dictating your life. While some pay attention to acting on it and the rest do not. Nowadays, procedures like Emsculpt, Emsculpt NEO®, Vanquish ME™, and others are changing how we look at body-shaping techniques.

Emsculpt NEO® is FDA-cleared non-invasive treatment to burn fat and build muscles. It is a 30min treatment that produces more than 20,000 muscle contractions and emits Radiofrequency to destroy fall cells while you are lying down. It is a procedure to help men and women build muscle and sculpt their bodies.

There is no beforehand preparation required for the appointment as it is a non-invasive procedure. The Emsculpt NEO® process is entirely painless. It is a 30min procedure where we strap the device panels onto your targeted area (stomach, butt, arm, or legs). The doctor turns the device to its lowest setting. The patient experiences contractions in a few seconds now and then. They are super-intense vibrations that reach your core. We will check in regularly to see if you are comfortable. The doctor then increases the intensity gradually, depending on your comfort level. Muscle contraction will be slower but powerful to flush out toxins or lactic acid in the last phase. You do not need a recovery time but may experience soreness like a workout. You can visibly see the changes in your body after the first treatment. For some patients, 2 to 4 sessions are enough, while some may need additional sessions. Our experts will assess and examine if you require any additional treatment to achieve your aesthetic goals during the consultation.

Patients can see improvement after their first treatment, with their results developing after four weeks of complete series. How long the effects last depend on the patient’s lifestyle! For example, if a person is active and able to maintain their toned body with regular exercise, the results can last longer. It can last indefinitely depending on how well you take care of yourself with a healthy diet and regular exercise!

Are you tired of body fat in areas that don’t go away? Marin Medical Aesthetics can help to find the most suitable treatment for you. You may contact us at (415) 785-4604 to learn more about Emsculpt NEO® and other treatment options.
